head: App Store Awards 2026 finalists: 45 apps and games picked by Apple
dek: Apple named 45 finalists for its 2026 App Store Awards across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Vision Pro and Apple Arcade, plus a Cultural Impact group. The iPhone App of the Year finalists are ElevenReader, (Not Boring) Camera and Raylie.
details: ElevenReader reads text aloud in AI voices, (Not Boring) Camera turns the iPhone into an old-style camera you can adjust, and Raylie guides you through each flight. On Apple Watch the finalists are Bevel, Moonlitt and StressWatch; on Mac, Paste, Things 3 and Ulysses. Apple says the winners come in the coming weeks.
where: Announced 18 November; winners in the coming weeks
means: If you're looking for new apps to try, the list is a ready shortlist across Apple's devices.
todo: Search the App Store for the finalists on your device; check each app's price and in-app purchases first.
thumb_words: APPLE'S 45 APP OF THE YEAR FINALISTS
